titles.title: Untitled (Abstraction/Portrait of Paul Strand)

description: Depicts artist Paul Strand. A twisting, black and red shape runs through the center of the composition like a tendril of smoke. Washes of yellow and gray paint surround the form, and they fade into black and red borders.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
